title: Cover MonacoCodeEditor layout-frame component wiring and zero-size/unmount behavior
outcome: Add focused component-level coverage for the actual MonacoCodeEditor routing to the frame owner; helper scheduling coverage already exists.
acceptance: A component test with stubbed Monaco, requestAnimationFrame and ResizeObserver verifies that multiple mount/options/resize requests produce one editor.layout per frame, zero dimensions skip layout, and unmount prevents a pending layout.
The test fails if component routing bypasses the frame owner or disposal is removed, and relevant focused checks pass on the exact candidate.
